title: Closure packs + privacy + zero-write audit
summary: Materialized a strict public Closure Pack metadata contract that rejects unknown fields, nested payloads and sensitive key classes.
Added a dependency-free fail-closed exporter plus deterministic self-test for safe export and private/free-text/signed-query rejection.
Declared concrete zero-write read/poll audit targets without falsely certifying uninspected implementations.
Declared semantic retention eligibility for terminal closures and verification evidence while excluding heartbeat/poll/progress/private exhaust.
No TTL, DELETE, VACUUM, pruning, migration, Supabase call, scheduler, queue or CURRENT was introduced.

tests.evidence: node self-test PASS; exporter and self-test local Git blob SHA matched GitHub exactly: 3da25259cee780c69657294bb625a8a4fc116105 and 17130823b0d1aa8aa7160db4c1b7597b52664374.
Contract forbids arbitrary free text, unknown fields and nested objects; exporter rejects transcript key, unknown summary field and query-bearing ref.

ZERO_WRITE_AUDIT defines claim-frontier, RUN packet/status, V11 refresh, project-context and worker-evidence read targets plus forbidden observation side effects. Certification remains explicitly pending per-target inspection.

Retention rules admit terminal closure/verification/lineage/boundary evidence; reject heartbeat, polls, presence, progress, raw runtime exhaust and private payload classes; no age-based TTL is guessed.
No Supabase/database tool was called; contract and retention rule explicitly forbid destructive actions in this RUN.
Each of six product commits was reopened and touches exactly one path under coordination/storage-recovery/github-native-v1/**; RETURN is the only second S010 write_scope path.

hard_gate_evidence.EVIDENCE_MAP: PASS; every S010 acceptance row maps to an executed/static check above.

unresolved_boundary.effect: S010 materializes the audit base but does not claim those external read paths are already zero-write certified.
